Gifted: Gravity.description:
🧬 Gravity, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start a fingertip touch floats a person or object up to about a car's weight until you release it, or drags someone you grab to their knees.
📈 With training: debris dropped on cue, rubble lifted off survivors, drifting wall leaps, unshakable anchors, one-handed car throws, crushing fields, a building held aloft.
⚠️ Whatever you float falls when you let go.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as nausea and dizziness build with the weight you change.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ochaco Uraraka (Zero Gravity).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Gravity.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Gravity family): Scale: the user changes the weight of what a bare fingertip or palm touches. At first: floats people and objects up to about a ton total (a small car) until a release gesture from anywhere in sight, or makes a held person about twice as heavy for a few seconds. More needs learned techniques. Limits: skin contact only, so full gloves block it; floated things keep momentum (a pushed car still hits hard) and drift in wind. Past the total, new touches do nothing; no push or pull at range; all of it falls if the user lets go or is knocked out. Quirk Strain: light: floating one person or object; moderate: making someone heavy, floating debris or rubble, drifting leap; heavy: anchoring something, throwing a car; severe: signature crush, holding up a collapsing building. Type: Emitter. Law: floating a person against their will is unlawful restraint; the user is liable for anything floated that falls on someone.
